sentences.zh: 上面列出了大约2,200个不同的联邦合同，并详细列出了哪个机构持有该合同、哪个供应商持有该合同，以及取消它节省了多少钱。

sentences.en: It is also sort of an effort to gamify it.

sentences.en: So how did you actually start to analyze all of this and start sifting through all those receipts?
sentences.zh: 那么你究竟是如何开始分析这一切，并开始筛选所有这些收据的呢？

sentences.en: Well, I worked with the Times' Upshot desk, a team of incredibly good data analysts and reporters.

sentences.en: So this public accounting of what they did only accounts for a small portion of this much bigger number they're claiming.

sentences.en: So then we start to look at the individual line items, the individual contracts they're saying they canceled.

sentences.en: And you notice one thing, which is that many of them, even by Doge's own accounting, accounted for zero savings.

sentences.en: And in many cases, those mistakes make the savings seem much, much bigger on the Wall of Receipts than it was in reality.

sentences.zh: 所以，这是一种蓄意的欺骗企图，还是说你怎么看这事？

sentences.en: But actually, that cut was made years prior, and you would think that whoever's flagging that to Doge would have known that from inside of the Treasury or wherever else.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们所知道的是，墙上的削减是由各个机构建议的。

sentences.en: So, is this a deliberate attempt at deception, or what did you make of this?
sentences.zh: 各机构将它们提交给Doge，然后Doge将它们贴在墙上。

sentences.en: Well, what we know is that the cuts that are on the wall are suggested by the agencies.
sentences.zh: 我无法揣测各机构人员的心思，不知道这究竟是他们的无能，

sentences.en: The agencies send them to Doge, and then Doge posts them on the wall.
sentences.zh: 还是他们试图通过用一些不花钱的虚假削减来抚慰

sentences.en: I can't get into the head of the people at the agencies to know if this is their incompetence
sentences.zh: Doge，从而避免做出真正的削减。

sentences.en: or if they are trying to maybe avoid having to make real cuts by, you know, sort of placating
sentences.zh: 不过，从这些情况中我们可以看出Doge自身的质量控制以及它对质量控制的兴趣。

sentences.en: Doge with some bogus cuts that don't cost them anything.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚其中某些说法是错误的，并不需要付出巨大的努力。

sentences.en: What we can tell, though, from looking at this is something about Doge's own quality control and interest in quality control.
sentences.zh: 比如，你不需要获得政府合同的硕士学位。

sentences.en: The amount of effort it takes to figure out that some of these claims are wrong is not huge.
sentences.zh: 你只需要点击链接，就会发现，哦，等等，这份合同在2005年6月就到期了。

sentences.en: Like, you don't need a master's degree in government contracting.
sentences.zh: 如果连这种错误他们都能漏掉，那就真的看不出有任何人真正在审核这些东西。

sentences.en: All you'd have to do is click on the link and realize, oh, wait, this contract expired in June 2005.
sentences.zh: 他们只是把这些东西贴在墙上，然后把功劳揽在自己身上。

sentences.en: And if they're missing that kind of mistake, it doesn't really seem like anyone is looking at these things.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，从他们声称在网站上做出的所有削减来看，他们实际节省的总金额到底有多少呢？

sentences.en: They're just sort of posting them on the wall and claiming credit for them.
sentences.zh: 不适用

sentences.en: So at the end of the day, how much total savings does it actually seem like they made out of all these cuts they claim on the website?
sentences.zh: 不适用

sentences.en: So I have not been through every single cut on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我还没有核对过清单上的每一项裁减。

sentences.en: We're still working through them.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在逐一处理。

sentences.en: But after we did some initial reporting, Doge deleted what had been the top five items on their original wall of receipts.
sentences.zh: 但在我们做了一些初步报道之后，Doge删除了他们原本收据墙上的前五项内容。

sentences.en: They got rid of all of them.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些全删了。

sentences.en: And the savings they had claimed from that, which had been over $10 billion, declined to a few million.
sentences.zh: 他们宣称因此节省的资金曾超过100亿美元，现在却缩水到了几百万。

sentences.en: That doesn't give me a huge amount of confidence for the accuracy of the rest of the data that we haven't gone through yet.
sentences.zh: 这并没有让我对我们尚未核对的其余数据的准确性抱有太大的信心。

sentences.en: So, OK, that is obviously a huge discrepancy between what they claimed and what you actually
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，这显然是一个巨大的出入，介于他们宣称的成果和你们实际

sentences.en: were able to verify, which, again, just sort of speaks to the idea that this isn't a super well-oiled operation.
sentences.zh: 能够核实的情况之间，这再次说明，这个机构并不是一个运作得非常顺畅的机器。

sentences.en: Can you just tell us a little bit about the people who are actually in charge of making and accounting for these cuts within Doge?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们简单讲讲在Doge内部真正负责制定和核算这些裁减措施的人吗？

sentences.en: The Times had a great story about the people who work for Doge.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》曾发表过一篇关于Doge员工的出色报道。

sentences.en: So we identified more than 40 people who are working either at the central Doge office, which is within the White House, or out in the agencies sort of under the control of Doge.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们确认了有40多名员工在Doge的中央办公室（位于白宫内）工作，或者在Doge管辖下的各个机构里工作。

sentences.en: And they're, by and large, not people who have experience in government.
sentences.zh: 而且他们大体上都不是那些拥有政府工作经验的人。

sentences.en: They're coders, they're software engineers, they're sort of people who are close to Elon
sentences.zh: 他们是程序员，是软件工程师，他们是一些紧随埃隆·

sentences.en: Musk and go from company to company.
sentences.zh: 马斯克并在不同公司之间跳槽的人。

sentences.en: And to the degree that they have experience managing large organizations, it's something like Twitter or Tesla or SpaceX, very different organizations, and as big as they are, much
sentences.zh: 就他们管理大型组织的经验而言，那也就是推特、特斯拉或SpaceX之类的公司，那是截然不同的组织，而且尽管体量庞大，但与

sentences.en: smaller organizations than the one they're in charge of now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在负责的庞然大物相比，依然小得多。

sentences.en: So, David, you have laid out how Doge has, intentionally or not, exaggerated its effectiveness
sentences.zh: 所以，大卫，你已经分析了Doge是如何有意或无意地夸大了其成效

sentences.en: and in cutting government spending so far, either because of mistakes or because of the types of contracts they're targeting.
sentences.zh: 无论是由于失误还是由于他们瞄准的合同类型，导致迄今为止在削减政府开支方面有所夸大。

sentences.en: But my impression overall is that Elon Musk and Doge are responsible in large part for eliminating entire agencies like USAID, for example, making massive cuts to the Environmental
sentences.zh: 但我的总体印象是，埃隆·马斯克和Doge在很大程度上要为废除整个机构（比如美国国际开发署USAID）承担责任，对环境保护

sentences.en: Protection Agency, encouraging all these workers to take a buyout.
sentences.zh: 局进行大规模裁员，并鼓励所有这些员工接受买断离职。

sentences.en: It's felt like a real bloodletting within the federal government, within the federal workforce, and that would obviously account for savings across the government.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是联邦政府内部、联邦劳动力队伍内部的一次真正的大换血，这显然是整个政府节省开支的原因。

sentences.en: So I guess what I'm saying is that I understand the importance in holding this exercise that Doge is doing to account and doing this audit.
sentences.zh: 所以我想说的是，我理解举办Doge正在进行的这项活动并进行审计的重要性。

sentences.en: But it kind of feels like when entire agencies are going away and being gutted, a little small potatoes to point out, like, some of the accounting errors on this liSt.
sentences.zh: 但当整个机构都在消失并被掏空时，去指出这份清单上的一些会计错误，感觉有点像是在小题大做。

sentences.en: Well, look, in the grand scheme of the federal government's budget and in the cuts that Doge is proposing to make, these mistakes are relatively small.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，在联邦政府预算的宏大蓝图以及Doge提议的削减计划中，这些错误相对来说确实很小。

sentences.en: But there's something bigger at stake here.
sentences.zh: 但这里还涉及更宏大的利益。

sentences.en: Doge is, of course, a team of people within the White House, but it's also an idea, a bigger idea about the shape of government, and it's an idea about how to cut government.
sentences.zh: Doge当然是白宫内的一个团队，但它也是一种理念，关于政府形态的更宏大理念，以及关于如何精简政府的理念。

sentences.en: That's why this look is so important, because this is our one chance, the one window we have to see the world as Doge sees it, to see what they know, what they don't know, to see
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这次审视如此重要，因为这是我们唯一的契机，是我们唯一能以Doge的视角看世界的窗口，去看看他们知道什么，不知道什么，去看看

sentences.en: what they understand and what they don't understand.
sentences.zh: 他们理解什么，不理解什么。

sentences.en: And looking closely at that, I think, gives us a lot of clues about what actually motivates
sentences.zh: 我认为，仔细审视这些能为我们提供大量线索，让我们了解究竟是什么在驱动

sentences.en: Doge, what actually motivates the cuts they're making, and some sense of where their effort is going to go from here.
sentences.zh: Doge，是什么在驱动他们正在实施的裁减，并让我们对他们下一步的工作方向有个大致概念。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》（Connections）这款游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的谜题之一，我非常喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis, and I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天都创作《拼字比赛》（Spelling Bee）和《字母之海》（Letterboxd）这两款游戏，我有一种叫做联觉的奇特现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚刚你们听到声音的这些人一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: So David, besides all of the mistakes that you uncovered, when you step back and you look at this wall of receipts, what is the bigger picture here?
sentences.zh: 所以大卫，除了你揭露的所有错误之外，当你退后一步审视这面收据墙时，更大的全局是什么？

sentences.en: What does all of this tell us about the larger project that is Doge?
sentences.zh: 所有这一切向我们揭示了关于Doge这个宏大项目的什么信息？

sentences.en: The most important lesson I think we can learn from the mistakes we're seeing here is that
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以从这里看到的错误中吸取的最重要的教训是，

sentences.en: we should throw out the idea that Doge is somehow able to process this huge amount of government data and find insights that no other people have had.
sentences.zh: 我们应该抛弃这种幻想：即Doge不知为何能够处理海量的政府数据，并发现其他人从未有过的真知灼见。

sentences.en: What Doge has been sold to us as is like it's tech support.
sentences.zh: 向我们推销Doge时，把它包装得像技术支持一样。

sentences.en: That's what Elon Musk calls it.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克就是这么称呼它的。

sentences.en: You know, these are like the geek squad for the government.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些就像是政府的极客小分队（Geek Squad）。

sentences.en: We're going to bring them in and they're going to find examples of waste and inefficiency that other people hadn't.
sentences.zh: 我们要把他们请来，他们将找出别人没有发现的浪费和低效的例证。

sentences.en: That's not only what we're seeing here.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是我们在这里所看到的。

sentences.en: You know, we're starting to see patterns and the choices they're making.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们开始看出他们所作选择背后的模式。

sentences.en: So far, it seems like they're focused less on the really big federal contractors, the defense contractors, the health contractors that make up the huge portion of federal spending.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他们似乎较少关注那些真正巨大的联邦承包商——占联邦开支绝大部分的国防承包商和医疗保健承包商。

sentences.en: Instead, they're going after larger numbers of smaller contracts with smaller firms, often owned by women or minorities, often when the cuts are real, and there are many cuts
sentences.zh: 相反，他们正在追查规模较小、数量众多的小型合同，这些合同通常由女性或少数族裔拥有，而且很多时候，这些裁减是真实的，并且在这份名单上有许多裁减

sentences.en: that are real on this list, they're motivated by ideology.
sentences.zh: 都是真实的，它们是由意识形态驱动的。

sentences.en: They're political decisions.
sentences.zh: 这些都是政治决定。

sentences.en: They're cutting USAID not because they've found some great fraud or waste or ineffectiveness at USAID doing the mission it was supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 他们削减美国国际开发署（USAID）并不是因为他们在USAID履行其应尽使命的过程中发现了什么巨大的欺诈、浪费或低效。

sentences.en: They just don't like USAID.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不喜欢USAID。

sentences.en: They think that mission, foreign aid, is not worthy of taxpayer money.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这种使命，即对外援助，不值得纳税人的钱去承担。

sentences.en: That's a political view some people have, people in the government have.
sentences.zh: 这是一些人、政府中的某些人所持有的政治观点。

sentences.en: But to say that it is some sort of analysis that goes beyond or above politics, there doesn't seem to be a lot of evidence of that kind of analysis in the data we've seen.
sentences.zh: 但若要说这是一种超越或凌驾于政治之上的某种分析，在我们所看到的数据中，似乎并没有太多这种分析的证据。

sentences.en: So then this is a view also into the ideology of Doge or maybe the Trump administration, but it also appears to be a show of force, actually.
sentences.zh: 因此，这也让我们得以一窥Doge或特朗普政府的意识形态，但实际上，这也似乎是一次武力的展示。

sentences.en: A shuttering an entire agency seemingly overnight sends quite a strong message about how power will be wielded in this administration.
sentences.zh: 几乎在一夜之间关闭一个整个机构，对本届政府将如何行使权力发出了非常强烈的信号。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: They've sent a lot of messages to that end that if you disagree with them, you could be a target.
sentences.zh: 他们为此发出了许多信号，表明如果你不同意他们的观点，你就会成为靶子。

sentences.en: You could have your funding, you could have your job taken away.
sentences.zh: 你的资金可能会被剥夺，你的工作可能会被夺走。

sentences.en: It's a very aggressive view of the way that a president imprints his ideology, his political goals on the government, but also on society at large.
sentences.zh: 对于总统如何将其意识形态和政治目标烙印在政府上，以及整个社会上，这是一种非常激进的看法。

sentences.en: And I think that's the real impetus behind what Doge is doing, despite its name, efficiency, despite Elon Musk's characterization of it as sort of the government's peak squad.
sentences.zh: 我认为这才是Doge所作所为背后的真正动力，尽管它的名字叫效率，尽管埃隆·马斯克把它描述为什么政府的极客小分队。

sentences.en: It's a political project, a very aggressive political project to carry out a political ideology, not some sort of analysis that's outside of politics.
sentences.zh: 这是一个政治项目，是一个极其激进的、旨在推行某种政治意识形态的政治项目，而不是某种脱离政治的分析。

sentences.en: But if this is about telegraphing and using Doge as this kind of instrument of political
sentences.zh: 但如果这关乎传递信号，并且把Doge当作这种政治

sentences.en: pressure, as you're describing, and cultural change, I just sort of wonder how you reconcile
sentences.zh: 施压和文化变革的工具（正如你所描述的那样），我只是有点好奇你如何将这一点与你之前告诉我们的情况调和起来

sentences.en: that with what you told us earlier, where these agencies are kind of duping Doge and doing just enough to appease them, basically, but not really taking seriously this mandate to
sentences.zh: 那些机构在某种程度上糊弄Doge，仅仅做足够的工作来安抚他们，基本上并没有真正认真对待取消

sentences.en: cancel a bunch of government contracts or other types of work.
sentences.zh: 一堆政府合同或其他类型工作的使命。

sentences.en: Like, does that reveal that Doge in some way is not going to necessarily be all that effective?
sentences.zh: 比如，这是否表明Doge在某种程度上不一定会有那么大的成效？

sentences.en: I think we're in the middle of a period that will settle that question.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们正处于一个将对这个问题见分晓的时期。

sentences.en: I do not think that's a subtle question.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是一个微妙的问题。

sentences.en: If agencies send bogus cuts to Doge, will Doge accept them?
sentences.zh: 如果各机构向Doge发送虚假的裁减方案，Doge会接受吗？

sentences.en: And does that allow them to avoid real cuts?
sentences.zh: 这是否让他们得以逃避真正的裁减？

sentences.en: It's part of the same open question as that email that Elon Musk sent out to all federal workers asking, you know, what were the five things you did last week?
sentences.zh: 这和埃隆·马斯克发给所有联邦雇员的那封询问“你上周做了哪五件事”的电子邮件属于同一个尚未解决的问题的一部分。

sentences.en: The first time we tried it, about a million government workers responded, but also a lot of them didn't.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次尝试时，大约有一百万政府员工做出了回应，但也有很多人没有回应。

sentences.en: And a lot of agencies told their people, don't respond.
sentences.zh: 并且许多机构告诉他们的人：不要回复。

sentences.en: That was the first time that Elon Musk had tried to do something with his very large power within the government, and it failed.
sentences.zh: 那是埃隆·马斯克第一次试图利用他在政府内部的巨大权力去做某事，而结果失败了。

sentences.en: And so this is a power struggle.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场权力斗争。

sentences.en: I don't think we're seeing it in public.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在公众面前看不到这一点。

sentences.en: In public, everybody's getting along.
sentences.zh: 在公众面前，每个人都相安无事。

sentences.en: What you're seeing there when Doge fails to catch a bogus cut that an agency sends it, you're seeing that kind of battle going out right at the trench level between who will
sentences.zh: 当Doge未能抓住某个机构发送给它的虚假裁减方案时，你所看到的是那种战壕级别的战斗正在直接展开，看看到底是谁来

sentences.en: shape the future of these agencies, the people who run them or Elon Musk?
sentences.zh: 塑造这些机构的未来：是运营这些机构的人，还是埃隆·马斯克？

sentences.en: And I don't think I see Elon Musk giving up anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我看不到埃隆·马斯克会随时放弃。

sentences.en: And the fear, of course, is that if Elon Musk does not give up, he and Doge are basically going to take a wrecking ball to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 当然，令人担忧的是，如果埃隆·马斯克不放弃，他和Doge基本上会对联邦政府使用大锤砸烂一切。

sentences.en: I mean, they already kind of have, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们实际上已经这么做了，对吧？

sentences.en: We've already seen these massive cuts.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了这些大规模的裁减。

sentences.en: But as they continue, they might end up cutting unnecessary waste, but may also cut things that really create pain for not just employees, but the general public.
sentences.zh: 但随着他们继续下去，他们可能最终会削减不必要的浪费，但也可能削减那些不仅给员工，而且给广大公众带来真正痛苦的事情。

sentences.en: Because as you explained, Doge doesn't really seem to know the ins and outs of government, and they're already making all of these kind of very simple mistakes.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所解释的那样，Doge似乎并不真正了解政府的内幕，而且他们已经在犯下所有这些非常简单的错误。

sentences.en: And who knows if they can actually fix things that they broke.
sentences.zh: 谁知道他们是否真的能修复他们破坏的东西。

sentences.en: But just to play devil's advocate, no one gave Elon Musk the benefit of the doubt when he bought Twitter and basically slashed his way through it.
sentences.zh: 但仅从唱反调的角度来看，当埃隆·马斯克收购推特并基本上对其进行大刀阔斧的裁员时，没有人对他抱持信任的态度。

sentences.en: Everybody said he doesn't know what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说他不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: He's cutting too much.
sentences.zh: 他裁得太多了。

sentences.en: He's not leaving enough people behind to leave this thing operational.
sentences.zh: 他没有留下足够多的人来让这个平台继续运转。

sentences.en: And obviously, lo and behold, Twitter is still up and running.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，瞧，推特依然在上线运营。

sentences.en: So I just wonder if there's some bigger lesson to take from that.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是在想，从中是否能吸取一些更大的教训。

sentences.en: I think there's two things to keep in mind.
sentences.zh: 我认为有两件事需要记住。

sentences.en: One is what we mean when we talk about Twitter surviving.
sentences.zh: 一是当我们谈论推特存活下来时，我们指的是什么。

sentences.en: Yes, Twitter exists.
sentences.zh: 是的，推特存在着。

sentences.en: There's still people, you know, posting posts there and reading it.
sentences.zh: 仍然有人在那里发帖和阅读。

sentences.en: It's not the same thing that it was.
sentences.zh: 它已经不是以前那个样子了。

sentences.en: The audience has changed.
sentences.zh: 受众已经变了。

sentences.en: The content has changed.
sentences.zh: 内容已经变了。

sentences.en: The experience of being on Twitter has changed.
sentences.zh: 使用推特的体验已经变了。

sentences.en: And I think some people left because of that.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些人正是因为这个原因而离开了。

sentences.en: So Musk sees that as a success.
sentences.zh: 所以马斯克认为这是一种成功。

sentences.en: And it seems like he is trying to apply that, like, slash it, cut everything, and then see what breaks, and then rebuild the things that broke, that approach to federal government.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来他正试图将这种方法——比如大刀阔斧、砍掉一切、然后看看什么坏了，再重建坏了的东西——应用到联邦政府身上。

sentences.en: The thing that stops me, and when I think about whether that approach can really be carried
sentences.zh: 让我感到困惑的是，当我思考这种方法是否真的能在联邦政府身上推行时，

sentences.en: forward with the federal government, is it's so different from Donald Trump's view of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 它与唐纳德·特朗普对联邦政府的看法截然不同。

sentences.en: He's not a cutter.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个热衷于大举削减的人。

sentences.en: He didn't run on cut in the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他竞选时并没有以削减联邦政府为口号。

sentences.en: He didn't govern this way the first time.
sentences.zh: 他第一次执政时也不是这样做的。

sentences.en: His vision of government was one that basically continued to give people the benefits that they wanted, Medicare, Social Security.
sentences.zh: 他对政府的愿景基本上是继续给人们他们想要的福利，比如医疗保险（Medicare）和社会保障（Social Security）。

sentences.en: He doesn't ask people in his campaign to make sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 他在竞选中没有要求人们做出牺牲。

sentences.en: He was saying, you know, I'm going to fight inflation.
sentences.zh: 他当时说的是，我要打击通货膨胀。

sentences.en: I'm going to fight illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 我要打击非法移民。

sentences.en: But for everything else, things are not going to change that much.
sentences.zh: 但对于其他一切，事情不会有那么大的改变。

sentences.en: We're not going to touch these big expenditures.
sentences.zh: 我们不会触及这些巨额开支。

sentences.en: We're not going to touch the Defense Department.
sentences.zh: 我们不会触及国防部。

sentences.en: Donald Trump didn't say, hey, I'm going to run for president.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普并没有说，嘿，我要竞选总统。

sentences.en: I'm going to slash the government back so deeply that, you know, it'll just be barely alive.
sentences.zh: 我要把政府大幅度削减，以至于它只会勉强维持生命。

sentences.en: That's Musk's vision.
sentences.zh: 那是马斯克的愿景。

sentences.en: And if it continues and it changes the experience for the worse of average folks, Trump is going
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况继续下去，并且让普通百姓的体验变得更糟，特朗普将

sentences.en: to be faced with the question of, do I stop my most powerful ally or do I defend my own vision of what government ought to be and the vision that voters sort of elected me
sentences.zh: 不得不面对这样的问题：我是该阻止我最有权势的盟友，还是该捍卫我自己的政府愿景，以及选民投票选我来

sentences.en: to carry out?
sentences.zh: 实现的愿景？

sentences.en: Right, because like as you're pointing out, voters didn't necessarily want some of these
sentences.zh: 没错，因为正如你所指出的那样，选民并不一定希望其中一些

sentences.en: cuts to affect them in the ways that potentially they could, because Elon Musk is getting access
sentences.zh: 裁减以潜在可能的方式影响到他们，因为埃隆·马斯克正在获取

sentences.en: to all kinds of payment information, data information, and nobody really knows what's going to be affected by that.
sentences.zh: 各种支付信息、数据信息，而没有人真正知道什么会受到这些的影响。

sentences.en: That's the fundamental difference here, right?
sentences.zh: 这才是这里的根本区别，对吧？

sentences.en: You can delete your Twitter account.
sentences.zh: 你可以注销你的推特账号。

sentences.en: You can stop reading Twitter and life goes on.
sentences.zh: 你可以停止阅读推特，生活照常继续。

sentences.en: But now if you apply that same sort of like cut first, measure later approach to government, then you're talking about people don't get their Medicare.
sentences.zh: 但现在，如果你把那种先砍后奏、边走边看的方法应用到政府身上，那么你谈论的就是人们拿不到医疗保险。

sentences.en: People don't, you know, the IRS doesn't answer your phone call when you have a question about your taxes.
sentences.zh: 人们，你知道的，当你对税收有疑问时，国税局（IRS）不会接听你的电话。

sentences.en: The park that you're going to visit doesn't open.
sentences.zh: 你要去参观的公园不开门了。

sentences.en: I don't think that the public and Trump's voters were prepared for this kind of change and to make it risks huge political pullback for Trump and pretty big disruptions for regular
sentences.zh: 我不认为公众和特朗普的选民为这种改变做好了准备，这样做给特朗普带来了巨大的政治反弹风险，也给普通

sentences.en: people.
sentences.zh: 人带来了相当大的混乱。

sentences.en: Right, because even for Trump voters who might have wanted smaller government, more transparency
sentences.zh: 没错，因为即使是对那些可能希望政府规模更小、对政府资金去向有更多透明度的特朗普选民来说，

sentences.en: and what the government spends its money on, there's definitely a tension, it would seem, between those priorities and what we're seeing with Doge, which is only a tiny fraction of
sentences.zh: 在这些优先事项与我们从Doge身上看到的情况之间，显然存在着一种紧张关系，Doge所宣称的成果只占他们声称的极小一部分，

sentences.en: what they claim they're up to, which makes you just sort of wonder what else is going on that we really don't have a window into right now.
sentences.zh: 这让你不禁好奇，还有什么其他事情正在发生，而我们现在根本没有窗口去了解。

sentences.en: Look, to me, this is a question about truSt.
sentences.zh: 听着，在我看来，这是一个关于信任的问题。

sentences.en: An enormous amount, historic amount of trust has been placed in Doge.
sentences.zh: 人们对Doge寄予了极大的、史无前例的信任。

sentences.en: This tiny little group of people, many of them with no government experience, has been given an unprecedented amount of data about government, an unprecedented amount of data
sentences.zh: 这个微小的群体中，许多人没有任何政府经验，却被赋予了前所未有的关于政府的数据量，前所未有的关于

sentences.en: about us, about Americans, and an unprecedented amount of power to change the way the government's going to look for years, for decades.
sentences.zh: 我们、关于美国人的数据量，以及前所未有的权力去改变政府未来几年甚至几十年的面貌。

sentences.en: And the question is, do they deserve that trust?
sentences.zh: 问题是，他们配得上这种信任吗？

sentences.en: And the one way we have to start to answer that question is to look at this little slice of data that they've made available about how they see the world, about the work that
sentences.zh: 我们开始回答这个问题唯一的方法，就是看看他们所提供的这一小部分数据，看看他们如何看待世界，看看他们

sentences.en: they're doing.
sentences.zh: 正在做的工作。

sentences.en: And so sloppy mistakes, obvious mistakes, in the first thing they show to the public, raises questions about whether they deserve the huge amount of trust they've been given.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在向公众展示的第一批内容中出现的低级错误、显而易见的错误，引发了关于他们是否配得上被赋予的巨额信任的质疑。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me on.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我做客。

sentences.en: On Monday morning, Doge deleted hundreds of additional mistakes found on its website, erasing $4 billion in savings that the group claimed to have found in government spending.
sentences.zh: 周一上午，Doge删除了在其网站上发现的数百个其他错误，抹去了该组织声称在政府开支中发现的40亿美元节省额。

sentences.en: It was the second time in a week that some of the biggest alleged savings were removed.
sentences.zh: 这是一家一周内第二次撤掉部分最大虚假优惠幅度的企业。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump said that sweeping tariffs on Canada and Mexico would go into effect
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统表示，针对加拿大和墨西哥的全面关税将于

sentences.en: on Tuesday, shattering hope that the administration would make a last-minute deal to avoid a trade war.
sentences.zh: 周二生效，这粉碎了外界对政府会在最后一刻达成协议以避免贸易战的希望。

sentences.en: The president is adding a 25% fee on all Mexican and Canadian exports, as well as an additional 10%
sentences.zh: 总统对所有墨西哥和加拿大的出口商品加征25%的关税，并对

sentences.en: on Chinese goods, saying that these countries have not done enough to stem the flow of drugs and migrants into the United States.
sentences.zh: 中国商品额外加征10%的关税，称这些国家在阻止毒品和移民流入美国方面做得还不够。

sentences.en: The tariffs are widely expected to disrupt regional supply chains and raise prices for consumers.
sentences.zh: 外界普遍预计，这些关税将扰乱地区供应链并推高消费者物价。

sentences.en: And in response to the news, the S&P 500 fell 1.8%, the biggest drop so far this year.
sentences.zh: 作为对这一消息的回应，标普500指数下跌了1.8%，创下今年迄今为止的最大跌幅。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration says it's suspending all military aid to Ukraine and will not resume
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府还表示，将暂停对乌克兰的所有军事援助，在乌克兰满足特朗普总统

sentences.en: shipment of arms and ammunition until Ukraine satisfies President Trump's demand to commit to peace talks with Russia.
sentences.zh: 关于承诺与俄罗斯进行和平谈判的要求之前，不会恢复武器和弹药的运送。

sentences.en: The move follows a heated exchange on Friday between Trump and Ukraine's president,
sentences.zh: 在此之前，特朗普与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基

sentences.en: Vladimir Zelensky, in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 周五在椭圆形办公室发生了一场激烈的争论。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由安娜·弗利和奥利维亚·纳特制作，玛丽·威尔逊和

sentences.en: Carlos Prieto.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·普里耶托提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 节目由M.J.

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn, with help from Patricia Willans.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩剪辑，帕特里夏·威兰斯提供了协助。

sentences.zh: 原创音乐由帕特·麦卡斯克和罗文·内米斯托创作，艾莉莎·莫克利担任音频工程。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel AbraMs. See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·亚伯拉罕斯。明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们将为节日期间的招待做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是对光线敏感的睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
